To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) structural alignment without using an upper ontology is not able to achieve good recall, 2) structural alignment via upper ontology improves significantly recall and precision, 3) the mixed method improves recall and F-measure independently on the used upper ontology, and 4) nonstructural alignment via upper ontology preserves precision and improves recall.
